No visible eye; rear of head, right cheek contour just visible toward screen RIGHT.
Preserve existing fine clean anime drawing and original outfit exactly. Do not redesign flowers, ruffles, bodice, hat, chain, hands or hair; reposition only by perspective and occlusion. Character stands still, arms down in same relaxed pose, skirt hangs under gravity with no wind. Same level orthographic camera. Keep full body vertically from y=90 to y=1450 centered at x=512 on a 1024x1536 transparent canvas. ONE complete character, no labels, no sheet, no floor, no background glow. True transparent alpha.
